title: St Patrick's Church of Ireland, Enniskerry
caption: St Patrick's, the Church of Ireland parish church at Enniskerry, photographed in 2006. William Somerville and Manon Brittain were married at "St Patrick's Church, Powerscourt" on 15 June 1968 {g:0682} {g:0683}; the archive takes that to be this church, the parish church of Powerscourt, but the profiles do not say so.
creator: David Staincliffe
note: Downloaded unaltered from Wikimedia Commons on 29 October 2026. Not a family photograph.
